title: Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial documents combine narrative disclosures, accounting metrics, corporate structures, management commentary, and time-dependent facts, making them difficult to represent using conventional chunk-based retrieval-augmented generation systems. This paper presents an auditable, schema-driven methodology for constructing temporal financial knowledge graphs from page-delimited documents parsed using a general purpose document intelligence service. Overlapping document windows undergo phased large language model extraction of structural entities, quantitative observations, and domain-specific relationships. Candidate graph elements are validated against predefined schemas and consolidated through scope-aware exact, normalized, fuzzy, embedding-based, and LLM-assisted entity resolution. translated_title: 可审计的金融知识图谱：基于模式驱动的构建与内在质量评估
translated_abstract: 金融文档融合了叙述性披露、会计指标、公司结构、管理层评论以及时间相关的事实信息，这使得传统的基于分块的检索增强生成系统难以对其进行表示。本文提出了一种可审计的、模式驱动的方法论，用于从经通用文档智能服务解析的按页分隔文档中构建时序金融知识图谱。通过重叠的文档窗口，分阶段利用大语言模型提取结构化实体、定量观测值以及领域特定关系。候选图谱元素依据预定义模式进行验证，并通过范围感知的精确匹配、规范化、模糊匹配、基于嵌入以及大语言模型辅助的实体消解进行整合。时间合并约束、确定性边去重、冲突感知的属性管理以及细粒度的溯源机制保留了发行方身份……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可审计的模式驱动方法，通过分阶段大语言模型提取、多策略实体消解、时间约束与细粒度溯源，从金融文档构建时序知识图谱并对其内在质量进行评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an auditable, schema-driven methodology that combines phased LLM extraction, scope-aware multi-strategy entity resolution, temporal merge constraints, and fine-grained provenance to construct temporal financial knowledge graphs with intrinsic quality evaluation.
